result.keywords: This article presents a novel blind and robust forensic method for detecting copy-move manipulation in video sequences by focusing on fast motion frames. The approach combines Singular Value Decomposition with a multiresolution decomposition strategy and applies Quantization Index Modulation to selected temporal regions in order to improve efficiency while preserving visual quality. By avoiding redundant processing of all frames, the method reduces computational cost and maintains robustness against compression, noise, filtering, and frame collusion. Experimental evaluation shows strong transparency and reliable detection performance on challenging video forgery cases.
result.title: Blind Robust Copy-Move Detection in Fast Motion Video Frames Using SVD and QIM
